{{Short description|Chinese organic chemist}}
{{family name hatnote|[[Xi (surname)|Xi]]|lang=Chinese}}
'''Xi Zhenfeng''' ({{zh|s=席振峰|p=Xí Zhènfēng}}; born April 2, 1963, in [[Henan]]) is a Chinese [[organic chemist]].

Xi received his B.S. degree from [[Xiamen University]] in 1983, and his M.S. degree from [[Nanjing University]], [[Zhengzhou University]] and [[Henan Institute of Chemistry]] in 1989. He joined Professor [[Tamotsu Takahashi]]'s group at the [[Institute for Molecular Sciences]], Japan, as a Ph.D. course student in 1993 and obtained a Ph.D. degree in 1996.

He took an assistant professor position at [[Hokkaido University]], Japan, in 1997, after he worked as a [[postdoctoral]] research fellow with Professor Takahashi at Catalyst Research Centre, Hokkaido University. In 1998, he joined the Department of Chemistry, [[Peking University]], China, as an associate professor and was promoted to professor in 1999. He is a [[Chang Jiang Scholar]] Distinguished Professor (since 2001) of Peking University. In 2015, he became the [[academician]] of [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].

His research interests are focused on [[organometallic chemistry]] and [[organic synthesis]], including development of synthetic methodologies based on selective cleavage of C–H, C–C and C–X [[Chemical bond|bonds]] mediated by organometallic compounds, development of organometallic [[reagent]]s, study on [[Reaction mechanism|mechanisms]] of [[Chemical reaction|reactions]] involving reactive organometallic [[Reaction intermediate|intermediate]]s, and synthesis of functional structures.<ref name="refname1"/>

He is now serving as editor or consultant for several international academic journals, including:
* ''[[Applied Organometallic Chemistry]]'' ([[John Wiley & Sons|John-Wiley]]), Associate Editor (since 2008).<ref name="refname2"/>
* ''[[Tetrahedron (journal)|Tetrahedron]]'' and ''[[Tetrahedron Letters]]'' ([[Elsevier]]), Board of Consulting Editors (since 2008).<ref name="refname3"/><ref name="refname4"/>
* ''[[Synlett]]'' and ''[[Synthesis (journal)|Synthesis]]'' ([[Thieme Medical Publishers|Thieme]]), Advisory Board (since 2009).<ref name="refname5"/><ref name="refname6"/>
* ''[[Asian Journal of Organic Chemistry]]'' ([[John Wiley & Sons|John-Wiley]]), Editorial Board (since 2012).<ref name="refname7"/>
* ''[[Organic Letters]]'' ([[American Chemical Society|ACS]]), Associate Editor (since 2013).<ref name="refname8"/>

He has been visiting professors for several universities/institutes in the worlds, including:
*[[Hokkaido University]], Japan, 2006
*[[University of Rennes 1]], France, 2007
*[[RIKEN]], Japan, 2010
